description: Dispatch an AI agent runner job with a natural-language intent. The runner autonomously selects the right agent, plans actions, and executes them. Returns a job ID you can poll with get_agent_job.

intent.description: What you want the agent runner to do. Plain English — e.g. "Summarise the last 5 files in the Research library and write findings to a new file called Summary."

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to your active workspace.

name: dispatch_agent_job
